claims.text: The giant stone statues of Easter Island are called moai.
Menhirs, dolmens and totems are other kinds of monument, not the Easter Island statues.
Most moai were carved from volcanic tuff at the Rano Raraku quarry.
Hundreds of moai remain at Rano Raraku, many of them unfinished.
